name: hom-platform
description: House of Movements digital platform — Phase 1 marketing website and lead API.

scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.scripts.seed
